steps: Here three teams need the same Jira and C R M tools. Pasting a copy of the tool code into each of three apps means those copies will drift apart.
So you build one M C P server, with a Jira create issue tool and a C R M lookup customer tool, over J S O N R P C. Keep the tools narrow, not raw sequel access.
First, TicketFlow calls tools list and gets two tools. Each one appears as M C P, server, tool, for example the Jira create issue tool, and it is listed in allowed tools.
Next, the Escalation Dashboard and Analytics plug into the same server and get the same two tools, with no new glue code.
Now TicketFlow sends a tools call, and the server reaches the Jira A P I with a token from the environment. For user actions, it can use per-user O Auth.
Jira answers that the issue was created, and the tool result returns to TicketFlow. That result is treated as untrusted data, and side effects still need approval.
Finally, one fix to the Jira tool lands in all three apps at once. Write once, reuse everywhere. Shared capabilities belong in M C P, private ones in a custom tool.
